summary: Deepgram Pay As You Go still grants $200 in signup credits with no credit card and no expiration. Separately, Flux TTS is free through September 14, 2026 (up to 45 concurrent streaming connections globally, 5 in EU/AU); standard pricing starts September 15, 2026. Flux TTS in Voice Agent is also free through that date. This updates the existing deepgram-free-credit listing; expiry_date stays null so the $200 credit is not archived when the Flux promo ends.
claim_steps: Click Sign Up Free at deepgram.com/pricing (no credit card required).
Create a console account and an API key.
Use the $200 credit on STT, TTS, and Voice Agent APIs (credits do not expire).
Use Flux TTS free through 2026-09-14 (45 concurrent streams globally, 5 in EU/AU).

social_proof.title: Deepgram Pricing | Scalable Speech-to-Text, Text-to-Speech & Voice Agent APIs
social_proof.text: Pay As You Go: No credit card required. Free $200 Credit then pay-as-you-go. Through September 14, 2026, developers can build with Flux TTS free with up to 45 concurrent streaming connections globally (5 in EU/AU). Standard pricing applies beginning September 15, 2026.
